people.name: Abner

people.name: Asahel
people.line: Son of Zeruiah, brother of Joab, killed by Abner

people.name: David
people.line: Anointed king of Israel, ancestor of Jesus Christ

people.name: Joab
people.line: Son of Zeruiah, commander of David's army

translations.web: Joab returned from following Abner; and when he had gathered all the people together, nineteen men of David’s and Asahel were missing.
translations.bsb: When Joab returned from pursuing Abner, he gathered all the troops. In addition to Asahel, nineteen of David’s servants were missing,
translations.kjv: And Joab returned from following Abner: and when he had gathered ➔ all the people together, there lacked of David's servants nineteen men and Asahel.
translations.asv: And Joab returned from following Abner: and when he had gathered all the people together, there lacked of David's servants nineteen men and Asahel.
